review_method: Both reviewers read all80 actual source/output/status-only pairs before casewise comparison; no per-case gold/exact fields. Prior aggregate scores were disclosed, not treated as casewise quality evidence.
no_output_hash_convention: Canonical null means no output. Root original review used SHA256(empty string) as an absence sentinel, preserved separately. No empty output or fallback is credited.
critical_scope: Accepted-output material meaning changes only. Four no-output rejections separately fail faithful/clean/joint.
development_scope: 16 consumed earlier dev cases +64 unused cases from same approved authored training corpus; not a fresh independent qualification test
